endpoints.description: Extract all clauses from a contract with category, importance, and text excerpts
Score overall contract risk by category from a specific party perspective with sign recommendation
Flag risky clauses with severity, explanation, impact, and suggested revision language
Identify standard clauses missing from the contract with risk of omission and suggested language
Compare two contracts for material differences, identify which is more favorable
Executive summary of contract terms including parties, key dates, payment terms, and obligations
Identify negotiation opportunities, walk-away conditions, leverage points, and concessions to offer
Execution readiness check before contract signing with recommended analysis workflow
ONE-CALL: full contract analysis — risk score, top risks, missing clauses, negotiation points, and signing recommendation
